article.title: Record flooding hits the U.S. as powerful tropical storms threaten Asia
article.author: Editor
article.content: Miami faces its longest-ever streak of moderate coastal flooding, historic floods sweep across the Southwest, and Typhoon In-fa and Cyclone Arnab threaten the Northern Mariana Islands and eastern India.
